conventions.units: shares, rates, AUROC and differences of shares are proportions (x100 = percent / percentage points)
conventions.ci: 95% percentile cluster bootstrap, 2,000 replicates, fixed seeds; see analysis/common.py
conventions.clusters: P1: item (episode id); detection and P4: episode. Pooled-over-victim estimates resample episode ids jointly across victims; victim-averaged AUROCs resample within victim.
conventions.missing: a record with est=null carries a 'reason'; nothing is imputed
conventions.confidence: P1 stated confidence and laundering of confidence are on the 0-100 scale of the answer
conventions.p_values: two-sided bootstrap p-values; Holm correction over the four primary estimands only
